coordinate_system: IFC world metres, no origin shift

F-SC1.name: Column inspection
F-SC1.region_rationale: 柱面是检测对象；黄色环带覆盖可达柱侧的观测站位。0.5–1.5 m 是本研究的工作距离假设，不代表设备认证参数。

source.region_rule: 0.5–1.5 m from column exterior surfaces; accessible annular working strip, excluding solids and unsupported areas.
source.limitations: Inspection viewpoints are scenario-derived, not measured tracks.

F-SC1.region_definition_priority: User-confirmed 16 scenarios; appendix not authoritative for region extents

F-SC2.name: Beam inspection
F-SC2.region_rationale: 梁及梁柱节点是检测对象；将其投影至可作业楼面并扩展 1.5 m，使邻近观测位置获得优先权。该距离是建模假设。

source.target: All eligible beams and beam–column nodes
source.region_rule: Accessible floor/platform locations within 1.5 m of the horizontal projection of the target beam/beam–column node; exclude suspended beam volume.
source.evidence_class: Direct target IFC + projected accessible working positions
source.limitations: NDT literature concerns robotic testing, not standardized site-wide stand-off distance.

F-SC2.region_definition_priority: User-confirmed 16 scenarios; appendix not authoritative for region extents

F-SC3.name: Slab-edge inspection
F-SC3.region_rationale: 楼板外缘和真实洞口边缘是风险与检测目标；黄色仅取边缘向内 0.5–2.0 m 的可达带，避免把远离边缘的楼面计为重点。

source.task: Slab-edge inspection task using a BIM-guided robot
source.target: Actual exposed slab perimeters and valid openings
source.region_rule: Inward accessible band 0.5–2.0 m from actual exposed slab/opening boundaries; exclude unsafe edge setback and open voids.
source.limitations: Task configuration inferred; not a separately validated special-purpose slab-edge robot.

F-SC3.region_definition_priority: User-confirmed 16 scenarios; appendix not authoritative for region extents

F-SC4.name: Layout marking
F-SC4.region_rationale: 放线目标来自结构柱网交点；黄色覆盖标记点及其连接路线。标记点半径 1.0 m、路线半宽 0.75 m 是接收点优先范围假设；中心线最小 IFC 净空 0.25 m，尚未核实放线机的实际扫掠外廓。

source.target: Defined floor reference/marking points near column-grid locations
source.region_rule: 1.0 m radius around each designated marking point, connected by a 1.5 m total-width route over completed floor surfaces.
source.evidence_class: IFC-derived reference geometry + specified target points
source.limitations: Floor-marking study does not specifically validate the selected structural-grid marks.

F-SC4.region_definition_priority: User-confirmed 16 scenarios; appendix not authoritative for region extents

F-SC5.name: Structural-material delivery
F-SC5.region_rationale: 材料从西侧交接点沿中央通道运往各作业跨；黄色覆盖规划运输路线及装卸点。0.9 m 半宽和 1.5 m 停靠半径用于表达优先范围；中心线最小 IFC 净空 0.30 m，载货机器人能否穿过瓶颈需按实际外廓另行检验。

source.target: Construction entry to selected structural delivery/drop-off nodes
source.region_rule: 0.75–1.0 m each side of planned delivery route centerline; 1.5 m radius at docking/unloading stops; clipped by clearance.
source.limitations: Delivery stops and entry location must be explicitly declared.

F-SC5.region_definition_priority: User-confirmed 16 scenarios; appendix not authoritative for region extents

F-SC6.name: Structural-material stocktaking
F-SC6.region_rationale: 盘点需进入指定的东西两侧材料暂存间并接近各处材料；因此整个可达房间优先，堆料占地除外。房间用途和位置为研究布置假设。

source.target: Dedicated 1F structural-material laydown area and inspection aisles
source.region_rule: 0.5–1.5 m accessible aisle alongside designated material piles; include short turn/inspection paths, exclude pile footprints.
source.limitations: Storage layout does not exist as IFC element.

F-SC6.region_definition_priority: User-confirmed 16 scenarios; appendix not authoritative for region extents

F-SC7.name: Structural-waste sorting
F-SC7.region_rationale: 分拣需在独立废料间内移动和操作；因此整个可达房间优先，设备占地除外。所选房间与材料间分开，位置为研究布置假设。

source.region_rule: 1.5–2.0 m radius around specified sorting/feeding workstations plus short waste transfer aisle, excluding equipment footprints.
source.limitations: Waste station coordinates must be declared, not claimed as IFC extracted.

F-SC7.region_definition_priority: User-confirmed 16 scenarios; appendix not authoritative for region extents

F-SC8.name: Safety monitoring
F-SC8.region_rationale: 安全巡检沿中央通道到达楼板外缘及洞口防护检查点；黄色覆盖声明的巡检路线和站位。路线半宽 0.9 m、站位半径 1.0 m 为接收点优先范围；中心线最小 IFC 净空 0.25 m，不可直接视为四足机器人临边安全轨迹。

source.target: Selected exposed slab edges and openings requiring repeated monitoring
source.region_rule: Valid inspection positions 1–2 m from selected hazard boundaries; exclude voids and hazardous surfaces and any locations outside receiver evaluation domain.
source.evidence_class: IFC hazard geometry + valid inspection-position constraints
source.limitations: Aerial positions outside the indoor receiver domain are invalid for indoor WAP weighting.

F-SC8.region_definition_priority: User-confirmed 16 scenarios; appendix not authoritative for region extents

E-SC1.name: Wall plastering
E-SC1.region_rationale: 抹灰对象是室内墙面，黄色沿可达墙侧布置。离墙 0.6–1.5 m（带厚 0.9 m）：内界参考 0.85 m 宽室内装修机器人半宽 0.425 m 加约 0.15 m **本研究余量**取整；外界参考约 1.5 m 工作半径，但**工作半径不是论文给出的底盘离墙距离**。两者构成可复算候选区，并非本机型在所有高度的认证工作范围；原 2.0 m 作为敏感性对照。

source.target: All designated unfinished interior wall faces
source.region_rule: Accessible wall-facing strip 0.5–2.0 m from the relevant face, clipped to floor free space; exclude wall body.
source.limitations: Wall finish status is not necessarily encoded by IFC.

E-SC1.region_definition_priority: User-confirmed 16 scenarios; appendix not authoritative for region extents

E-SC2.name: Architectural inspection
E-SC2.region_rationale: 当前黄色仅针对 IFC 门窗目标的可达观察侧，取 1.0–2.0 m 候选站位带；若检测任务还包含指定墙面，需先给出墙面清单并补入模型。距离与视场尚未按相机实测校准。

source.region_rule: 1.0–2.0 m accessible observation-position neighborhood in front of target elements; local turning space, not whole rooms.
source.evidence_class: Direct IFC targets + viewpoint and access rules
source.limitations: Requires view/occlusion checks; not every window is necessarily reachable.

E-SC2.region_definition_priority: User-confirmed 16 scenarios; appendix not authoritative for region extents

E-SC3.name: Finishing-material delivery
E-SC3.region_rationale: 装修材料从西侧交接点经中央走廊进入目标房间；每个房间取内部代表点作为交付目标。在可通行网格上要求路径中心离障碍至少 0.3 m，对应参考小型运输机器人 0.6 m 最小通行宽度；固定路点之间搜索最短路径。黄色路线半宽 0.6 m、交付点半径 1.0 m 是围绕该可行中心线的通信/作业优先范围，不等同设备安全通道；载荷外廓不得超出通道净宽。

source.target: Entrance, central corridor, door-connected delivery route to chosen finishing stops
source.region_rule: 0.75–1.0 m each side of feasible path centerline, plus 1.5 m radius at delivery/docking stops, all within clear floor area.
source.limitations: Door clearances and robot/load dimensions must be checked.

E-SC3.region_definition_priority: User-confirmed 16 scenarios; appendix not authoritative for region extents

E-SC4.name: Joint filling and sealing
E-SC4.region_rationale: 填缝对象是实际门窗框接口；黄色沿可接近接口生成 0.5–1.5 m 作业带。IFC 未明确给出的墙板拼缝不另行虚构。

source.target: Designated accessible building-element joints needing sealing
source.region_rule: 0.5–1.5 m accessible work strip beside selected joint segments; do not include all wall/window intersections without sealing specification.
source.evidence_class: IFC candidate interfaces + declared joint targets
source.limitations: IFC geometric intersection is not evidence of sealant requirement.

E-SC4.region_definition_priority: User-confirmed 16 scenarios; appendix not authoritative for region extents

E-SC5.name: Floor surface operation
E-SC5.region_rationale: 地板机器人面向各层可达地面工作；因此除楼梯踏步和平台外，全部可达楼面均为黄色，不用任意路线宽度限制覆盖。墙柱实体和不可达空间依现有导航域排除。

source.region_rule: Designated tiling workspace, with repeated placement/repositioning stations; exclude unrelated floor areas and fixed obstacles.
source.limitations: The IFC does not establish tile finish or exact foyer boundary.

E-SC5.region_definition_priority: User-confirmed 16 scenarios; appendix not authoritative for region extents

E-SC6.name: Stair cleaning
E-SC6.region_rationale: 清洁对象是实际楼梯踏步和平台；黄色覆盖真实暴露踏面及出入口最多 1.0 m 的接近区域，不扩展到普通楼面。

source.target: All applicable stair flights and landings in the stair cores
source.region_rule: Actual stair tread and landing operating areas plus up to 1.0 m access/turning extension at accessible entry/exit positions.
source.evidence_class: Direct IFC stair geometry + local access extension
source.limitations: Use 3D stair elevation, not a flat XY footprint alone.

E-SC6.region_definition_priority: User-confirmed 16 scenarios; appendix not authoritative for region extents

E-SC7.name: Finishing-material stocktaking
E-SC7.region_rationale: 库存盘点需要覆盖指定材料房的可达位置；黄色是整个房间，材料堆占地除外。东西两端各一间，房间用途属于研究布置假设。

source.region_rule: 0.5–1.5 m material-facing inspection aisles and short access/turning paths; exclude material storage footprint.
source.limitations: Actual laydown plan must be declared.

E-SC7.region_definition_priority: User-confirmed 16 scenarios; appendix not authoritative for region extents

E-SC8.name: Finishing-waste sorting
E-SC8.region_rationale: 废料分拣需要覆盖独立分拣房的可达位置；黄色是整个房间，分拣设备占地除外。房间与材料房分开，位置属于研究布置假设。

source.region_rule: 1.5–2.0 m radius around sorting/feeding workstations plus short accessible transfer aisle, excluding equipment.
source.limitations: Keep distinct from E-SC7, but overlaps of access routes are legitimate.

E-SC8.region_definition_priority: User-confirmed 16 scenarios; appendix not authoritative for region extents
